portfolio.rationale: The prior replace and delete mechanisms produced balanced or strongly regressive outcomes, so these variants use narrower causal targets: the materiality criterion and the unconditional repository-inspection directive. The prior add mechanism showed the best improvement-to-regression balance and its wording is already present in the baseline, so the new add strategy extends that successful mechanism only to the remaining development signal: unrequested exhaustive acceptance examples. Each strategy targets a different exact passage and makes the smallest edit aimed at a distinct observed error source.
